content: Vercel Functions (2026): request+response body hard cap 4.5MB (413 FUNCTION_PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE) on Node runtime - large audio must go to Storage not through the function body. maxDuration: default 300s Hobby-ish; Pro/Enterprise up to 800s GA, 1800s beta, configured via maxDuration export. Fluid compute + Active CPU pricing: billed only during active CPU (/bin/bash.128/CPU-hr) not during I/O wait (LLM/STT calls), + provisioned memory /bin/bash.0106/GB-hr. Streaming responses supported on Node runtime.
